title: Domain analysis load cases and generic combinations

sourceOracles.coverage: generic combination abstraction, load-case assignment and load-combination evaluation

independentValidation.method: Strict declaration consumer coverage and independently executed pinned JavaScript versus built TypeScript analysis classes, including exact JSON, Unicode, inheritance, instanceof, assignment, cloning and error-path comparisons.

tolerances.serializedParity: exact JSON serialization for combinations and load cases
tolerances.numericParity: exact equality for generic linear combination evaluation
tolerances.publicStrings: exact equality plus Unicode code-point equality

parityDifferences: The slice preserves the source generic combination abstraction, load-case assignment, shallow metadata cloning, factor storage, evaluation defaults, serialization, inheritance and errors.
Domain load subclasses, NTC action/load catalogs, NTC combination factories and engineering formulas remain outside this bounded slice.
engineeringFunctionality: Generic solver-neutral load cases and linear combinations only; no domain load catalog or normative combination formula is introduced.
